data.long_meaning: From the Greek word ‘εἰρήνη’ (eirēnē), meaning ‘peace’ or ‘harmony’. In Christian tradition, the name Irina is associated with the Virgin Mary and symbolizes the peaceful nature of the divine mother. The name Irina carries the meaning “Peace, harmony” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Irina usually hope their child will grow to embody peace, harmony and live with faith, good character and purpose.
